# DataBG

> DataBG provides structured Bulgarian data, APIs and machine-payable tools for AI agents, developers and automated systems.

## Website

- [Home](https://databg.tech/): DataBG overview and agent-native data platform.
- [Tools](https://databg.tech/tools.html): Catalog of machine-payable API tools.
- [Datasets](https://databg.tech/datasets.html): Structured data resources.
- [Doctors dataset](https://databg.tech/doctors.html): Bulgarian doctors dataset and API information.
- [Documentation](https://databg.tech/docs.html): API and integration documentation.
- [About](https://databg.tech/about.html): About DataBG.

## API tools

- [Web Page Extraction](https://databg.tech/tools/web-page-extraction/): Fetch a public page and return structured metadata, visible text and links.
- [Web Page Metadata](https://databg.tech/tools/web-page-metadata/): Extract SEO, Open Graph, Twitter and technical metadata.
- [DNS Lookup](https://databg.tech/tools/dns-lookup/): Resolve public DNS records for a domain.
- [SSL Certificate Check](https://databg.tech/tools/ssl-certificate-check/): Inspect publicly logged TLS certificate information.
- [Wallet Balance](https://databg.tech/tools/wallet-balance/): Check native ETH balance on Base Mainnet.
- [IP Geolocation](https://databg.tech/tools/ip-geolocation/): Resolve public IP geolocation and network information.
- [Domain Lookup](https://databg.tech/tools/domain-lookup/): Combine public DNS and TLS certificate intelligence for a domain.

## Machine-readable resources

- [DataBG discovery](https://api.databg.tech/.well-known/databg.json): Machine-readable tool and capability catalog.
- [OpenAPI](https://api.databg.tech/openapi.json): API specification.
- [x402 discovery](https://api.databg.tech/.well-known/x402): Machine-payment information.

## Payments

DataBG tools support x402 machine payments in USDC on Base Mainnet.
